cards.title: Summer Childcare: Learning from Orangutans
cards.body: With six weeks of school holidays ahead, parents face the annual challenge of arranging affordable, memory-making activities. Scientists reveal that orangutans arrange playdates for their offspring, and research shows that unstructured play benefits children's health and development.

cards.title: New Mothers' Real Concerns Beyond Incentives
cards.body: Amid discussions of declining birthrates, policymakers are proposing medals and cash bonuses to encourage childbearing. New research reveals deep anxieties among new mothers, highlighting that policy should address their real concerns rather than offering surface-level incentives.

cards.title: Can We Teach Children to Be Kinder?
cards.body: Recent research suggests that kindness in children can be actively taught and developed. The effects of kindness training extend far beyond the virtue itself, creating broader positive impacts on children's behavior and relationships.

cards.title: Family Trauma's Impact on Adult Relationships
cards.body: Unresolved childhood wounds create emotional vulnerabilities that shape romantic relationships in adulthood. Understanding these early patterns can help individuals recognize and heal family trauma's lasting effects.

cards.title: Sibling Bonds After Parental Divorce
cards.body: Sibling relationships are often the longest relationships people maintain throughout their lives. Divorce can either strengthen these bonds or fracture them, depending on how family conflict is managed.

cards.title: Fathers Listening to Children Without Judgment
cards.body: Healing words between fathers and children often come through listening rather than speaking. When fathers listen without explaining themselves, old family wounds soften and new hope emerges.

cards.title: School Dread Before the Year Begins
cards.body: Parents of children with Neuroimmune Reactive Avoidance face anxiety as the school year approaches. Understanding and preparing for potential flare-ups can help families navigate the transition.

cards.title: Purity Culture's Impact on Young People
cards.body: Those raised in purity culture experience significant psychological and sexual difficulties in adulthood. Understanding these effects can help parents and educators support healthier attitudes toward development.

cards.title: Shame's Hidden Role in Youth Suicide
cards.body: Shame is a significant but underestimated driver of suicide, particularly in adolescence. Better awareness and healthier ways of addressing shame can help protect vulnerable young people.

cards.title: Parents' Unspoken Wishes About Struggling Adult Children
cards.body: Most parents of struggling adult children harbor wishes they're too ashamed to admit. Speaking these feelings aloud helps parents gain perspective and find constructive ways forward.
